author: wittjosiah
principle: An API's return type should be directly usable by its natural downstream consumer without requiring a cast -- design the types so they compose.
fix_shape: Adjust the return type of the producing function so its output satisfies the consuming function's parameter type without a cast.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: A general-purpose/core package must not take a dependency on a UI-specific package merely to reuse a type -- keep dependency direction pointing from UI down to core, not the reverse.
fix_shape: Move the shared type into a lower-level package both sides can depend on, or duplicate/derive it instead of importing the UI package.

author: wittjosiah
principle: Prefer composing existing reusable primitives (e.g. matcher/combinator functions) over writing new bespoke conditional logic that duplicates their behavior.
fix_shape: Build the new predicate by combining existing matcher primitives instead of writing fresh conditional logic.

author: wittjosiah
principle: Extract a substantial React component (one with real logic) out of a capability/wiring file into its own container component, rather than defining it inline.
fix_shape: Move the component into its own container file and import it from the capability module.

author: wittjosiah
principle: When adding an entry to an existing lazily-loaded registry/module list, follow the same lazy-loading pattern as the existing entries -- do not eagerly import it.
fix_shape: Wrap the new export in the same lazy-loader factory (e.g. `Capability.lazy`) the sibling entries use.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Reuse the existing shared type/schema builder instead of hand-rolling an equivalent definition, even when working around a circular-import constraint.
fix_shape: Import and reuse the existing Ref/schema type rather than redefining an equivalent one inline.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Guard every transition of a shared resource's lifecycle with the same lock/mutex the rest of its lifecycle uses -- do not add a second synchronization primitive for a subset of the transitions.
fix_shape: Use the same mutex/synchronization mechanism (e.g. the resource-open/close lock) for the new transition instead of a different one like `@synchronized`.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Split an operation that changes both a resource's logical state (e.g. marking it deleted) and its physical lifecycle (e.g. closing it) into two focused methods rather than one method doing both.
fix_shape: Have the state-changing method (`delete()`) put the resource into a terminal state, and a separate method (`close()`) handle teardown; call one from the other if needed.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: A low-level property-setting helper should not itself perform the enclosing mutation transaction (e.g. an object-update wrapper) -- leave that orchestration to the caller so callers can batch multiple sets in one transaction.
fix_shape: Have the setter mutate the already-open draft directly; require callers to wrap the call in the update transaction themselves.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Use the library-provided type-guard/predicate function (e.g. `Either.isLeft`) rather than comparing an internal discriminant tag directly.
fix_shape: Replace the `_tag === 'Left'` comparison with the library's semantic predicate.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Do not rely on a synchronous shortcut (`runSync`) on an API whose backing implementation may become asynchronous -- design an async-first API mirroring an existing sibling API instead.
fix_shape: Add a proper async/Effect-returning query method matching the sibling API's shape instead of forcing the current sync call.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Delete code whose only purpose was serving a mechanism that has since been replaced -- do not leave it as dead residue.
fix_shape: Remove the now-unused operation/module entirely instead of adapting it to the new mechanism.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Do not add a second mechanism (a new class, a new storage path, a hand-rolled lookup) to serve a concern an existing mechanism (registry, query API, lock) already serves -- extend or reuse the existing one.
fix_shape: Route the new need through the existing mechanism/API instead of building a parallel one.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Do not add a second mechanism (a new class, a new storage path, a hand-rolled lookup) to serve a concern an existing mechanism (registry, query API, lock) already serves -- extend or reuse the existing one.
fix_shape: Route the new need through the existing mechanism/API instead of building a parallel one.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: An operation/handler should declare a dependency on the service tag (e.g. `Database.Service`) rather than accepting an already-resolved instance as input, so it composes through the DI/Effect layer system.
fix_shape: Change the operation's input/services to require the service tag instead of a pre-resolved value.

author: mykola-vrmchk
principle: Reuse an existing shared test helper/fixture instead of hand-writing an equivalent one-off implementation at the call site.
fix_shape: Call the existing helper (or extract the stub into the package's shared `testing/` module) instead of duplicating it.

fix_shape: Call the existing helper (or extract the stub into the package's shared `testing/` module) instead of duplicating it.

author: mykola-vrmchk
principle: Reuse an existing shared test helper/fixture instead of hand-writing an equivalent one-off implementation at the call site.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Do not add a thin delegation wrapper (function/module) around an existing primitive unless it adds real behavior -- call the underlying primitive directly.
fix_shape: Remove the wrapper and call the wrapped primitive directly at each use site.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Organize a package's exports around a clear public surface -- hide implementation details in an `internal/` directory and only re-export the intended public API, rather than blanket re-exporting all submodules.
fix_shape: Move internal-only code into `internal/` and replace the wildcard re-exports with explicit exports of only the public API.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Do not add an API overload solely to handle passing `undefined` -- let callers branch instead of the API silently no-op'ing on a missing value.
fix_shape: Drop the `undefined`-accepting overload/variant from the API surface.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Do not add API overloads solely to handle passing `undefined` -- let callers branch instead of the API silently no-op'ing on a missing value.
fix_shape: Drop the `undefined`-accepting variants from the API surface.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Define a composition/wiring helper next to the thing it wires (e.g. inline where the service/registry is defined), not as a separate reusable-looking utility elsewhere.
fix_shape: Inline the layer/definition into the module that defines the resource it wires, and delete the standalone helper.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: In tests, construct dependencies using the real factory/constructor the production code uses, rather than reimplementing a stub that mimics its shape.
fix_shape: Build the test double via the production `makeRegistry`-style factory instead of a hand-written stub object.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Put a reusable test stub/fixture in the package's shared `testing/` module and import it, rather than hand-writing an equivalent stub at each call site.
fix_shape: Extract the stub into `<package>/testing` and import it from every test that needs it.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Do not add a second mechanism (a new class, a new storage path, a hand-rolled lookup) to serve a concern an existing mechanism (registry, query API, lock) already serves -- extend or reuse the existing one.
fix_shape: Expose the derived value as a property on the existing query-result object instead of a separate standalone function for the same thing.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Structure a package as namespace-exported modules: capitalized module files re-exported via `export * as Foo from './Foo'` in `index.ts`, with implementation hidden under `internal/` and the module marked `@import-as-namespace`.
fix_shape: Reorganize the package into per-concept namespace files re-exported from index.ts, with private helpers under internal/.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Name an internal-only namespace import using the repo's `internal` naming convention, not an ad hoc suffix like `Impl`.
fix_shape: Rename the import alias to follow the `xxxInternal`/`internal` convention used elsewhere.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Declare a simple read-only interface member as `readonly prop: T` rather than a `get prop()` accessor, unless the getter performs real computation on each access.
fix_shape: Replace the getter with a `readonly` property of the same type.
